claim: Anyone else cringes when people say «good morning»?
summary: I mean, the "good morning" is the worst for me. When someone gets up -- dishevelled, clothes all wrinkled, dark circles on their eyes -- and says «Good~ morning!» (notice the annoying accentuation on "good"), with a raspy, hoarse voice, I almost vomit. It's so cheesy and pointless! I already know people wish that I have a good morning...
